data.name: Aabis
data.gender_notes: Aabis is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Frowning; stern; austere (also recorded as the name of a Companion)
data.long_meaning: From Arabic ʿābis (عابس) 'frowning, stern, austere', the active participle of ʿabasa 'to frown', from the root ʿ-b-s. It is also recorded in name-lists as the name of a Companion (Sahabi), though that attribution is not independently confirmed here. Aabis therefore means “Frowning; stern; austere (also recorded as the name of a Companion)”. Arabic active participle ʿābis 'frowning, stern'. The 'name of a Sahabi' attribution appears in popular name-lists but is not confirmed by a primary source here.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabis expresses “Servant”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Arabic ʿābis (عابس) 'frowning, stern, austere', the active participle of ʿabasa 'to frown', from the root ʿ-b-s. It is also recorded in name-lists as the name of a Companion (Sahabi), though that attribution is not independently confirmed here.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabis total 14, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

faq.q: What does Aabis literally mean in Arabic?
faq.a: Aabis is the Arabic active participle ʿābis (عابس), from the root ʿ-b-s, and literally means 'frowning' or 'stern'. Some name-lists also record it as the name of a Companion, but that attribution is not confirmed by a primary source.

faq.q: What does the name Aabis mean?
faq.a: Aabis means “Frowning; stern; austere (also recorded as the name of a Companion)”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aabis come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aabis?
faq.a: The root of Aabis is ع-ب-س (ʿ-b-s).

faq.q: How is Aabis written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aabis is written عابس in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aabis a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aabis is used as a male name.

faq.q: Does Aabis appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aabis is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aabis verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Frowning; stern; austere (also recorded as the name of a Companion)” is established by Arabic active participle ʿābis 'frowning, stern'. The 'name of a Sahabi' attribution appears in popular name-lists but is not confirmed by a primary source here..
